espn-603993.headline: Ireland fret over one wrist. Argentina have a longer list
beats: Sam Prendergast spent last week in rehab with a wrist injury, and Paul O'Connell's verdict is that "he looks like he could be OK." Argentina have already lost Santiago Carreras, 70 caps, and prop Thomas Gallo, 39, with centre Santiago Chocobares in doubt after a head knock.
Argentina have won once this year, against Wales in July. Since then they have lost at home to South Africa and Australia, then drawn the return with Australia 28–28.
Ireland have not played since a 21–40 loss to New Zealand in July, which ended a run of four wins. They have been third in the world all the while, and a home defeat here would put France above them.
A week later Ireland host Fiji and Argentina go to Italy, two sides still without a point. Whoever arrives there with fewer people on crutches has the easier November.

espn-603994.headline: Italy's one win over South Africa is ten years old
beats: Italy's sole win over South Africa came in Florence in 2016, 20–18. South Africa have won the other 18. The last of those was in Turin, 32–14, on 15 November 2025.
South Africa scored six tries in Australia in September and still lost, 38–42. Italy went to Australia in July, scored two, and lost 10–57. That followed a 47-point afternoon in New Zealand.
Do it again and Italy climb to ninth in the world, and New Zealand take first place off South Africa before they go to France six days later.

Erasmus has six uncapped players in the touring squad. If Markus Muller debuts, he becomes the youngest Springbok of the professional era, taking a record Frans Steyn set 20 years ago. That record is twice as old as Italy's win.

espn-603995.headline: Thirty-three goes, two draws and still no win
beats: The draws came in 1964 and 1983. Gregor Townsend lost to New Zealand 62–31 and 69–20 as a player and admits "I don't think we ever felt we could win the game." As a coach he has lost to them by five, eight and eight.
In November 2025 at Murrayfield, Scotland fell 17–0 behind, came back to 17–17 and still lost 25–17. Townsend's verdict on the gap: "We might have lacked the composure."
New Zealand put 50 and 43 on Australia in October, straight after three defeats by South Africa. Scotland have not played since beating Fiji in July.
Win, and Scotland climb above England to fifth in the world. Nobody in Edinburgh would mention it first.

sources.title: Townsend never felt he could beat All Blacks as a player, but as a coach...

espn-603996.headline: Last time it was one point. It still is
beats: Wales won the last meeting 24–23 in Cardiff on 15 November 2025. They meet on the same ground ninth and tenth in the Nations Championship, Wales one point ahead, each with one win from three.

In July 2025 Japan won 24–19 in Kitakyushu, a result that stretched Wales's losing run to 18 Tests. Wales have not played since July, when they lost 35–21 in Argentina and then 43–0 in South Africa without scoring a try.

Japan have played more recently, losing 34–28 at home to Fiji on 24 October, a month after beating them. Win by any margin and Japan go above Wales in the world rankings, with Wales dropping below Italy, who have no Championship points.
Whoever loses gets New Zealand in Cardiff or England away the following weekend, neither of them a likely place to win the point back.

sources.title: Wales losing streak up to 18 tests after losing to Japan in boiling Kitakyushu

espn-603997.headline: Fiji have had a head start in Lyon since Tokyo
beats: Jake White flew ten of the side that beat Japan 34–28 in Tokyo on 24 October straight to a camp in Lyon. Players from the Lyon club have since joined them, and the drills have been about getting lower and underneath opponents.

The numbers favour the hosts. France scored 42 in each of their last two Tests and won the last meeting 34–21 in November 2025. Fiji are bottom of the Nations Championship without a point, and conceded 73 to England in July.

Mickael Guillard knows where the danger sits: "On a loose ball or a turnover, they have players behind them capable of making incredible plays, as we see every weekend in the Top 14." One of them is his club team-mate Jiuta Wainiqolo, whom he calls "a phenomenon."
A Fiji win would drop France below England in the world rankings. Guillard says France have not discussed South Africa, who come five days later. Fiji would like them to have been thinking about it.

espn-603998.headline: England have had three days. Australia, ten Tests
beats: England have not played since beating Argentina 31–24 on 18 July. Their squad had a three-day camp before going back to their clubs, while Australia have played ten Tests since July. Borthwick's answer is "doing more of less".

The less includes discipline: 98 penalties in eight Tests this year, 14 yellow cards and one red. Lawrence Dallaglio wants the RFU to hire Wayne Barnes to fix it. Fin Smith is a fitness worry, and Alex Mitchell limped off for Northampton with a suspected hamstring.
Australia's hardening came at a price. They beat South Africa 42–38, then conceded 50 and 43 to New Zealand in October. England won the last meeting 25–7 at home, in November 2025.
Win at Allianz Stadium and Australia go fifth in the world, above England and Scotland. That is what ten Tests are supposed to buy.

espn-603999.headline: France can hand New Zealand top spot from Saint-Denis
beats: South Africa have been first in the world only since 31 August. On 27 September they lost 42–38 away to Australia.
The sides met on 8 November 2025, with France at home, and South Africa won 32–17. In July France scored six tries in each of their wins away to Australia and Japan.
In early October, France were being written up as the northern side best placed to challenge South Africa and New Zealand. This is where that gets tested.

Win, and France go up to third while South Africa drop to second. The new number one would be New Zealand, a side South Africa beat three times running at home in August and September, taking top spot without playing.

sources.title: France are ready to join Springboks, All Blacks, as rugby's third superpower

espn-604000.headline: Italy still on zero, with Argentina in the way
beats: Italy have yet to score a Nations Championship point. They lost all three July games away, conceding 27, 47 and 57, and only Fiji have a worse points difference.

Argentina have won once in 2026, against Wales in July. Since then they have lost by seven, seven and six, then drawn 28–28 with Australia. Each game got closer without quite getting there. They open November against Ireland in Dublin.

Italy meet South Africa in Turin first, and Gonzalo Quesada is already blaming the calendar for a growing injury list. Beat Argentina in Genova and Italy go up to ninth in the world, above Fiji and Wales.
Fiji come to Udine on 21 November, also without a point. Italy would rather that be Fiji's problem alone.

espn-604001.headline: Four months off, and Wales get the side that put 52 on them
beats: Wales's last Test was on 18 July, a 0–43 loss away to South Africa. New Zealand spent the gap losing three times to the same opponents, then putting seven tries on Australia in each of two October Tests.
The last meeting was in Cardiff last November and finished 26–52. That was Wales at home, in a friendly.

New Zealand arrive level on points with South Africa at the top of the Nations Championship, and still testing depth. Jamie Hannah, 24, made his debut against France in July and is now picked ahead of Patrick Tuipulotu for these Tests.
A win lifts Wales above Fiji to ninth in the world. They host Australia a week later, a side New Zealand have just beaten twice.

espn-604002.headline: Japan's best hope is England's yellow-card habit
beats: England have been shown 14 yellow cards and a red in 2026, and Steve Borthwick has spent the build-up asking them to keep 15 players on the field. Lawrence Dallaglio counts 98 penalties conceded in eight matches.

England arrive on two wins, the second a 31–24 escape in Argentina, which ended a five-match losing run that included a first Six Nations defeat by Italy. Japan beat Fiji 20–15 in September, lost to them 28–34 in October and dropped three places in the rankings.

England put 73 on Fiji in July. That should settle it, unless England spend half the afternoon with 14 men. A Japan win at Allianz Stadium would send England down to 7th, below Scotland and Australia.
New Zealand come to London a week later. Seventh is a poor place to start that one from.

espn-604003.headline: A win changes nothing for Ireland. Anything else does
beats: Ireland have been third in every world ranking since July. A draw at the Aviva would drop them to fourth, below France.

Ireland's last game in this competition was a 40–21 loss to New Zealand. Fiji have no Nations Championship points after conceding 73 to England at home in July, but their most recent Test was a 34–28 win away to Japan last month.
Jake White has named four uncapped players in a 35-man Fiji squad for France, Ireland and Italy.

A week later Ireland host South Africa, and Fiji go to Italy, the other side in the table still without a point. Ireland would like to reach the first with third place intact. Fiji may see the second as the likelier chance.

sources.title: Fiji squad: Ex-England international makes Test return as Jake White names four uncapped players for Nations Championship

espn-604004.headline: Sixth place changed hands in October. Now it's back up
beats: Australia were sixth in the world until 19 October. Two days earlier they had lost 43–21 at home to New Zealand, a week after conceding 50 in the away leg, and Scotland went past them without playing.
Win at Murrayfield and Australia take sixth straight back. Scotland's answer this year has been tries: seven against France and seven against Argentina, though they let in 40 and 38 doing it.
Les Kiss has reached for Kurtley Beale, 37, with 95 caps and no Test since 2021. He sees him as a contender in the race for the No 10 shirt at next year's home World Cup.
Scotland's fly-half, Finn Russell, will be 35 by that tournament and has just said he plans to play on after it. Australia are still auditioning.
